questions.question: List five structural differences between prokaryotes and eukaryotes.
questions.solution_html:
• Nucleus: Prokaryotes lack a true nucleus; Eukaryotes have a membrane-bound nucleus. .
  • DNA: Prokaryotes have circular DNA; Eukaryotes have linear chromosomes. .
  • Organelles: Prokaryotes lack membrane-bound organelles; Eukaryotes have them .
  • Wall: Prokaryotes have peptidoglycan; Eukaryotes have cellulose or chitin . Cell
  • Size: Prokaryotes are generally smaller than Eukaryotes
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025
questions.final_answer: Size: Prokaryotes are generally smaller than Eukaryotes
